notes: These regexes are matched against CommandExec.cmd + args by gateway/enforcement.py before subprocess execution. A match raises ForbiddenCommandError; the gateway never runs the command. This list is defense-in-depth, not the primary control -- the primary control is that FileOp has no 'read' op and command_exec output is always truncated to output_lines/max_command_output_lines regardless of what the command prints.
